title: From Perception to Punchline: Empowering VLM with the Art of In-the-wild Meme
abstract: arXiv:2512.24555v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generating humorous memes is a challenging multimodal task that moves beyond direct image-to-caption supervision. It requires a nuanced reasoning over visual content, contextual cues, and subjective humor. To bridge this gap between visual perception and humorous punchline creation, we propose HUMOR}, a novel framework that guides VLMs through hierarchical reasoning and aligns them with group-wise human preferences. First, HUMOR employs a hierarchical, multi-path Chain-of-Thought (CoT): the model begins by identifying a template-level intent, then explores diverse reasoning paths under different contexts, and finally anchors onto a high-quality, context-specific path. This CoT supervision, which traces back from ground-truth captions, enhances reasoning diversity. translated_title: 从感知到笑点：赋予视觉语言模型创作真实场景梗图的艺术
translated_abstract: 生成幽默的梗图是一项具有挑战性的多模态任务，它超越了直接的图像到文本描述的监督范式，需要对视觉内容、上下文线索以及主观幽默进行细致入微的推理。为了弥合视觉感知与幽默笑点创作之间的差距，我们提出了HUMOR，这是一个新颖的框架，通过分层推理来引导视觉语言模型（VLM），并将其与群体层面的人类偏好进行对齐。首先，HUMOR采用分层的多路径思维链推理：模型首先识别模板层面的意图，然后在不同的上下文下探索多样化的推理路径，最终锚定到一条高质量、特定于上下文的路径。这种从真实描述回溯得到的思维链监督增强了推理的多样性。我们进一步分析表明，在高质量路径保留显著（文本在此处截断）的实际条件下，这种带锚定的多路径探索能够维持较高的预期幽默质量。
tldr: 提出HUMOR框架，通过分层多路径思维链推理与群体人类偏好对齐，赋予视觉语言模型在真实场景中创作幽默梗图的能力。
en_tdlr: HUMOR empowers VLMs to generate humorous in-the-wild memes through hierarchical multi-path Chain-of-Thought reasoning and alignment with group-wise human preferences.
